name: Flujo de Textura
algorithm: Texture Flow — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes texture flow patterns in video for deepfake detection:

1. **Textura Flow Estimación**: The motion field of texture elements (rather than edge features) is estimated using oriented texture correlation between frames. This captures how textured regions (skin, hair, fabric) move over time.

2. **Textura - Movimiento Consistencia**: Texture flow should be consistent with optical flow — texture moves with the surface it belongs to. The method compares texture flow with geometric optical flow (from edge features). Inconsistencies indicate texture that moves independently of the underlying geometry — a possible AI generation artifact.

3. **Superficie - Textura Coherencia**: As surfaces rotate, textures foreshorten according to perspective. The method checks whether texture deformation is consistent with the estimated surface orientation change. Deepfake face generators may rotate faces without properly foreshortening skin texture.

4. **Textura Temporal Estabilidad**: Fixed textures (skin pores, wrinkles, fabric pattern) should maintain their spatial relationship to surface geometry across frames. The method tracks texture-surface binding — texture that "slides" relative to the surface (like a projection rather than a surface property) indicates AI rendering.

5. **Textura Flow Boundaries**: Texture flow should be continuous within objects and show discontinuities only at object boundaries (depth edges, occlusion boundaries). The method detects texture flow discontinuities within surfaces — internal flow breaks corresponding to face-swap boundaries reveal the extent of generated regions.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through textoure flow analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Zheng, Y. et al. (2021). Exploring Temporal Coherence for More General Video Face Forgery Detection. ICCV.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
